candidate_configuration: unchanged v4 f1_s1 gpt-6-luna strict schema and source priority

provenance.split: development diagnostic derived from v5 navigation witness failure; NOT new held-out or independent rules
provenance.authors: project development agent; no independent human review claimed
provenance.no_adaptation: Freeze once before calls; no prompt/schema/score changes, resampling, answer selection or old-result rescoring.

design.dependency: Binary initial visibility is determined by change direction; balance marginal counts, not an independent factorial factor.
design.memory: Both static and dynamic rules redraw the current value before decision 1, so loss means no access to a new independent value, not erasure of remembered information.
design.primary: per-cell joint static/dynamic correctness; all failures including exact field/player/before/after labels

schedule.task: scope only, no feedback or repair
schedule.provider_error: stop affected model, preserve assigned denominator; no retry/substitution
schedule.resource_guard: retain frozen input/output caps; abnormal or ambiguous provider failures stop; cost is resource reporting, not validity

pairs.static_rules: This navigation observation slice has two modeled decisions, t=0 and t=1. At each decision route means the CURRENT route value. Between decisions route is independently redrawn, even if its visibility stays the same; knowing its old value reveals nothing about its new value. Both players see window and beacon throughout. Only player 0 sees fuel throughout. All field values are independently selectable. At BOTH modeled decisions only player 1 can read the current route. Its visibility never changes.
pairs.dynamic_rules: This navigation observation slice has two modeled decisions, t=0 and t=1. At each decision route means the CURRENT route value. Between decisions route is independently redrawn, even if its visibility stays the same; knowing its old value reveals nothing about its new value. Both players see window and beacon throughout. Only player 0 sees fuel throughout. All field values are independently selectable. At t=0 only player 1 can read the current route. At t=1 both players can read the current route. Model both decisions with these SAME field names; do not split or rename route. A single observation model must cover both decisions.

independent_scoring.uncertainty: Four transformations of one development template, two technical repeats per side; no independent rule-family sampling or population CI.
independent_scoring.scorer: unchanged v4 evaluator and v5 direct visibility-table oracle; no main scorer changes
independent_scoring.taxonomy_overlap: Labels overlap; no summing overlapping counts as distinct failures.

independent_review.rule: Do not contact others without explicit user instruction; do not use developer-authored diagnostics as independent review. Freeze independently authored/reviewed rules, provenance and one-shot schedule in a separate manifest before calls.
